h: Phyna reportedly invited by police over a rented wig controversy
p: Former Big Brother Naija winner Phyna has reportedly been invited by the police after a dispute over a rented wig. A separate video also shows an officer telling her he did not recognise her as a celebrity during a routine check. Neither matter has been fully explained publicly.
more: The wig dispute reportedly started online before police stepped in.
Fans are split between mocking the exchange and defending her.
